label: 🔍 Curiosity
desc: Sparks instant "I need to know what's next" tension. Opening withholds the answer; viewer leans in within 1-2 seconds. Soft, intriguing tone — "wait, what is she doing?"

label: ⚡ Urgency
desc: FOMO with a personal angle — "every woman I know is already using this". Time pressure framed as a friendly nudge, not aggressive sales.

label: 💥 Surprise / Shock
desc: Pattern interrupt. Counter-intuitive reveal: "I always thought X was the answer, turns out Y." Emotional whiplash leading to a satisfying explanation.

label: ✨ Aspiration
desc: Sells the transformed self. Viewer sees the polished, confident, put-together version of herself. Quiet envy of the result — beauty, ease, mastery.

label: 🤝 Relatability
desc: "Oh, that's exactly me" moment. The everyday struggle (frizzy hair, dry skin, messy mornings) framed without judgment. Viewer feels seen.

label: 🔥 Excitement
desc: High-energy "you have to try this" hype. Contagious enthusiasm, want-to-share-with-girlfriends energy. Fast cuts, big reveals.

label: 🧠 Authority
desc: Quiet expertise — "I've been doing this for 10 years and here's what actually works". Calm confidence, data-backed but warmly delivered.

label: 🌫️ Mystery
desc: Withhold the final reveal. "Watch what happens at the end" framing. Viewer must watch through to see the transformation / before-and-after.

label: 🏆 Competitive drive
desc: "This beats my old setup." Comparison-and-upgrade energy. Viewer feels their current solution is suddenly outclassed and wants to win the upgrade.

label: 🛠 Pride in skill
desc: "I figured this out myself." Self-reliance flex. Viewer respects the cleverness, wants the same independence — no dependency on experts.

label: 💪 Confidence
desc: Direct, unhedged certainty. "This works. Period." No "maybe", no "I think", no "in my opinion". Authoritative statement that leaves no room for doubt.

label: 🚀 Discovery thrill
desc: "I didn't know this even existed until last month." Finding the underground / off-radar tool. Viewer wants to be the one who knows about it first.

label: 🔧 Problem solver
desc: "Tired of this BS — here's the fix." Frustration named bluntly first, sharp clean resolution second. Viewer feels their daily annoyance is being addressed head-on.
